svg.title: Eidetic Studio — System Overview v7
svg.text: v8 · July 2026 · Octatrack clock master · Patchbay-central · Hybrid stem capture (In 5–6) · BM9S monitor chain · DJM-850 guest input (front 1–2)
Audio · ¼″ TRS / XLR (balanced where possible)
• PreSonus USB-C DIRECT to Mac — never via hub • No macOS Aggregate Device
• Soundcraft mains feed PreSonus In 7–8 — NEVER the monitors directly
• Speaker path is exclusively PreSonus Main Out → BM9S → HS8
• Soundcraft & DJM-850 USB stay UNPLUGGED from the Mac (audio-wise)
• USB = transfer/storage ONLY — no Overbridge on MKII
• Samples must be 44.1 kHz WAV/AIFF — 48 k plays at wrong pitch
• Realtime timestretch clean within ~±10% — pre-conform the rest
• Cue L/R → PreSonus 3–4 = parallel stem capture
Performance sampler · scenes · crossfader · live FX
Main L/R → PB 9–10 → SC stereo ch 9/10
MIDI Out → Digitakt MIDI In (chain head)
In A/B ← Aux send bus (PB 15–16) · C/D ← PB 17–18
Sample layer: loops/vocals hot-switched · 44.1 k prepped
Drum sampler · p-locks · physical MIDI THRU · no timestretch
Drum synth · internal per-track mixer + FX
Assign 1 (KICK) → PB 1 → SC 1 dbx limiter · per-kit
NO Thru port — Soft Thru: ON re-sends clock
MIDI In ← Digitakt Thru · Out(≡Thru) → TB-03
Acid bass · end of MIDI chain
Out (3.5mm mini!) → PB 2 → SC 2 dbx limiter
No DIN involvement · not in clock chain
half-normal mults a copy — SC 1/2 still fed
Analogue summing · tactile faders · USB unplugged
TR-8S Kick · dbx LIMITER — drive it
TB-03 acid · dbx LIMITER — drive it
Gain-stage WARM: peaks ~ −6 dB per channel,
trim the master — analogue colour is the point.
Main Mix L/R (XLR) → PS In 7–8 · XLR(F)→TRS
Aux 1/2 → OT In A/B = per-channel FX send into the OT
GRP 1/2 → DT In = press 1-2 button, hit sample (resample)
Zero Aux + GRP sends on ch 9/10 — feedback loop risk
DJ mixer for set practice / recording — analogue in only
REC OUT (RCA) → 2× RCA→XLR(M) → PS FRONT In 1–2
REC OUT ignores master knob — consistent record level
Monitor via Mode 1 (UC Surface direct) · record in Live
Preamp gain saved in UC Surface — recallable, set once
⚠ NEVER its USB soundcard into the Mac (Aggregate rule)
⚠ Not through the Soundcraft — front inputs keep it simple
Sole interface · monitor controller · recallable preamps
IN 1–2 FRONT (mic/inst · preamp) ← DJM-850 / vocal mic
IN 5 (rear line) ← dry KICK · PB row 1 front tap
IN 6 (rear line) ← dry TB-03 · PB row 2 front tap
IN 7–8 (rear line) ← Soundcraft Main Mix (glued sum)
Rear line ins bypass the preamps — clean, direct-to-ADC
MAIN OUT L/R (TRS) → BM9S SAT/SUB IN (XLR)
2× headphone outs · UC Surface zero-latency mon.
USB-C → Mac mini — DIRECT, no hub
Hybrid capture: SUM + dry kick + dry bass in one pass
Inputs: 1–2 DJM · 3–4 OT cue · 5–6 stems · 7–8 SUM
Stem tracks (5/6) = “Sends Only” → drive Rumble return
Powered hub → DT · TR-8S · OT(data) · MiniLab
Audition loops/vocals warped (Complex Pro) at set tempo
OT-bound samples: resample 48 k → 44.1 k first!
SUB LP ~80 Hz · phase 0/180 by ear · ~29 Hz extension
Mono single driver = the mono-sub discipline check
Fed from BM9S SAT OUT — arrives high-passed
OT Clock Send OFF · by hand.
SOUND TARGET — CHLÄR · CHONTANE · ANNĒ · HEMKA · ROSATI
Rumble kicks: kick split to SC 1, dbx limiter driven, Aux 1 → OT In A thru-FX, resampled & layered under the dry kick · dry stems (In 5–6) drive the in-the-box Rumble return.
Sample layer: loops · toms · percussion · rap vocals — auditioned warped in Ableton (Complex Pro), prepped to 44.1 k bar-trimmed pool for OT hot-switching (±10% realtime stretch).
Analogue colour: warm gain per channel · OT scenes/crossfader for groove · capture every jam · RCA 11/12 = reference, INTERVAL MUTE = instant A/B · mono-sub truth via BM9S.
